# Velair 1.9.0

A stable release bringing household arrival planning, shared climate control and more flexible schedules, with improved recovery, mobile editing and documentation. These notes cover all changes since **1.8.0**.

## ✨ Added

- **Planned Return** prepares rooms for weekly or one-off arrivals. Explicit one-off returns also work without occupancy sensors.
- **Room groups** share schedules and adaptive control across climates, while **Profile exceptions** retain individual room routines. Thanks to @adri123 ([#55](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/55)) and @intru91 ([#38](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/38)).
- **Shared Climate presets**, fully linked or hours-only templates, and grouped-day editing reduce repeated configuration. Temperature-only blocks preserve the HVAC mode. Thanks to @Hellsing ([#42](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/42)).
- **Supply control** coordinates shared heating or cooling switches using estimated demand, hysteresis and protection delays, with manual-off suspension, live status and an optional dashboard card.
- **Scheduled Room Assist references** and optional **Comfort backup sensors** support changing or unavailable sensor sources. Thanks to @mperone ([#69](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/69)) and @scastiello ([#71](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/71)).
- Preconditioning master relationships coordinate room preparation. Automations can pause rooms until the next scheduled block, and a seasonal-selection blueprint supports winter, mild-weather and summer actions.

## 🚀 Improved

- Presets, Room groups and shared supplies work over local HTTP. Thanks to @Mimic33 ([#77](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/77)).
- Broader compatibility with climates requiring range setpoints in Heat, Cool or Auto, including selected range references for adaptive control. Thanks to @Glooob-domo ([#51](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/51)).
- Reduced repeated scheduling and monitoring work, clearer delivery Diagnostics and bounded recovery using the current climate intention. Thanks to @lorenzosp93 ([#62](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/62)) and [GuiPoM](https://community.home-assistant.io/u/guipom).
- More readable mobile editors, content-sized Sections cards, accessible HVAC menus and clearer pause controls. Thanks to @C2gl ([#47](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/47), [#48](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/48), [#52](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/52)).
- Refreshed website, accessible screenshot viewer and reorganized documentation, with real Home Assistant captures covering all major features. Expanded contextual help and translated guides; thanks to @jimbexleyspeed ([#34](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/34)).
- Automatically maintained dashboard resources where Home Assistant manages them, plus public Quality reports and separate checks for release packages and committed HACS files.

## 🛠️ Fixed

- Prevented skipped blocks and premature actions in other rooms during preconditioning. Thanks to @madnazz ([#39](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/39)).
- Restored reliable Profile reopening and editing. Thanks to @toshi903 ([#50](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/50)).
- Preserved the intended temperature when restoring device presets after Boost. Thanks to @RonRoozendaal ([#59](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/59)).
- Corrected decimal entry in schedule, Profile, template and Climate-card Boost editors. Thanks to @pier-andre ([#64](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/64)) and @fuzzy01 ([#68](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/68)).
- Prevented off-state placeholder temperatures from triggering false Manual adjustments. Thanks to @bdonohoe ([#65](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/65)).

## 🧭 Notes

- Existing configurations migrate automatically. New optional features remain opt-in. Creating Room groups adopts common settings and resets learning; review before saving.
- Portable exports use model **26**. Older backups remain importable; older Velair versions cannot import new exports. Keep a pre-update backup for downgrading. Imported supplies remain disabled and suspended; imported Planned Return automation remains disabled until reviewed.
- Performance measurements remain informational; installation-level investigation of [#62](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/62) and desktop card-picker behavior in [#43](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/43) continue. Translated guides await human linguistic review.
- After updating through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the browser or Companion app. Remove existing numeric Sections row overrides or use **auto**.
